AlertAcknowledgeRequest.description:
Body is optional — the path param carries alert_id; occurred_at is
required because (alert_id, occurred_at) is the primary key of the
hypertable and a single alert_id may exist at multiple timestamps on
re-delivery edge cases.
AlertAcknowledgeRequest.title: AlertAcknowledgeRequest

RefreshRequest.description:
Mobile-only refresh payload. Web clients send the refresh token as
the httpOnly ``strix_refresh`` cookie; mobile clients that can't hold
cookies reliably pass it in the request body instead.
RefreshRequest.title: RefreshRequest

RegisterRequest.description:
Open self-registration. New users land in the `analyst` role; only
an existing admin can promote them. The `designation` is a free-form
label the SOC uses to track callsigns / shift identifiers.
RegisterRequest.title: RegisterRequest
